final.rationale: The verified source records confirm that simplified onboarding drives completion (+13%), reduces time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improves 30-day retention (+3%). Memory_31 showed signup simplification lifted SMB activation by 9% and qualified revenue by 4% despite a minor retention dip (-1%), indicating the gain is sustainable at scale. With onboarding completion down 4% QoQ and activation down 6% QoQ, repeating the proven simplification approach addresses both metrics directly. While competitive pricing pressure exists, a well-executed onboarding experiment recovers product-led momentum and strengthens qualified revenue quality more durably than discounting. The standard_experiment scale allows confident measurement within one week without overcommitting resources. This preserves uncertainty about whether the prior gains replicate in current conditions while leveraging the strongest available evidence.
